pages.text: Mei's doll was upstairs in the mountain lodge. A long wooden staircase led up.
Mei looked up from the bottom. The lights were off, hiding the top of the stairs.
At the sound, Mei's feet stopped. One foot moved back.
Night came. Mei tossed and turned under the covers without the doll.
Mei got out of bed. Upstairs, there wasn't a sound.
Mei stood by the stairs again. They were still dark.
Grandma Bear attached a little bell to Mei's scarf. "When you're scared, make a sound."
Mei shook the bell and climbed the stairs. Jingle, jingle.
Mei came downstairs with the doll in their arms. Jingle, jingle.
